note: The floor lane is pinned to the oldest Defold version build.defold.com still compiles native extensions for. yes2games/yes2sdk-defold#29 sections 5 and 9 pin 1.6.0, and 1.6.0 is not buildable: the extender answers HTTP 501 'Engine version d9e9c49ab946c058f29a8b688c862d70f30e9c43 is not supported on the current server'. Measured by probing POST /build_async/<platform>/<engine sha> once per version on 2026-09-11: 1.6.0 through 1.10.1 refused, 1.10.2 and 1.10.3 accepted on js-web, 1.10.4 and newer accepted on wasm-web.
